name: spec-resolutions
body:
Spec-writer resolutions, defect confirmations, and user-directed scope changes (each confirmed against the code graph):

1. Positional shape of plan update/rm. SPEC §3's table omits `<project>` from the update/rm phase and task rows (e.g. `apg plan rm phase <n>`) while `add` takes `<project>` first and the disambiguation rule keys on the first positional. Resolved: EVERY plan subcommand takes `<project>` as the first positional — `apg plan update <project> phase <n>`, `apg plan rm <project> phase <n>`, etc. [autonomous]

2. Task rm refusal scope. SPEC §3 says refuse if `done` "or has open Feedback"; SPEC §4 says refuse on "any incident Feedback". Resolved toward the stricter §4 scope: refuse on ANY incident Feedback, because removing a task would otherwise strand its (even resolved) Feedback mirror. [autonomous]

3. All five defect anchors verified against source: node_add builds a bare NodeFile and write_project overwrites (validate_change exempts the overwritten FQN from uniqueness); edge_add pushes out+in with no dedup; plan_add_phase_at/task_at/planned_at each call artifacts::remove_node then re-add. plan_init_at already refuses. [autonomous]

4. Live re-add test in this worktree: re-adding an existing solution container (`node-edge-surface`) via `apg node add` succeeded and upserted the file — the running binary does NOT refuse on existing, directly reproducing defect 1. The correct body was thereby installed without loss only because the node had zero incident edges. [autonomous]

5. rm commit-path defect — IN SCOPE (user decision). `apg node rm solution container node-edge-surface` failed with a libgit2 error — `could not find '<path>' to stat: No such file or directory; class=Os (2); code=NotFound (-3)` — after the file was removed and before the auto-commit, and the mutation rolled back. Grounded cause: node_rm passes the deleted path in `deletes`; write_through_with_deletes builds `paths = write_paths + deletes` and commits ALL of them via git::commit_files, whose `index.add_path(rel)` (src/git.rs:583) stats and cannot stage a deletion → NotFound → rollback. Covered by requirements.requirement.rm-commit-stages-deletions and solution.component.mutation-commit-staging. [user decision: in scope]

6. Coverage-gate scope change — user-directed. `coverage_check` (src/plan_cmd.rs:1097) was global over the cumulative `apg/layers/` store with no requirement-reachability filter, so it forced any new plan to fabricate `modifies` tasks for prior projects' already-implemented code (e.g. worktree-cleanup's project-delete/dispatch/merge and project-command, anchored to real `apg.project_cmd.cmd_project` / `project_merge_at`). The gate is now scoped to the plan's own spine: for every requirement a `PlanPhase` `Satisfies`, walk Requirement → Drives → Domain → RealisedBy → Solution → SpecImplementedBy and require every reached solution node's implemented-by FQN be touched by ≥1 plan task; additionally every solution node ADDED ON THIS BRANCH must be touched; pre-existing nodes unreachable from a satisfied requirement are exempt (no fake tasks). The branch delta may use `apg.git.origin_default_branch` (src/git.rs:340). Covered by requirements.requirement.coverage-spine-scoped and solution.component.coverage-spine-validation. [user-directed: in scope]
